column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the transport vehicle record.
An enum (VehicleKind_enum) describing the vehicle type (e.g., 'Refrigerated Truck', 'Cargo Aircraft', 'Reefer Container').
A REAL number for the current measured temperature (°C) inside the vehicle.
A REAL number specifying the vehicle’s current speed in km/h.
A NUMERIC(9,2) indicating the distance already traveled (in kilometers).
A NUMERIC(9,2) specifying the remaining distance (in kilometers) until destination.
A TIMESTAMP for the estimated time of arrival at the destination.
A VARCHAR(100) naming the departure location/site.
A VARCHAR(100) for the current location or site.
A VARCHAR(100) naming the destination location/site.
An enum (GPSTrackingStatus_enum) for GPS tracking status (e.g., 'Active', 'Lost', 'Limited').
A DOUBLE PRECISION value for the vehicle’s current latitude.
A DOUBLE PRECISION value for the vehicle’s current longitude.
A REAL number denoting the vehicle’s altitude in meters above sea level.
A SMALLINT specifying how frequently (in minutes) the vehicle’s location data is updated.
A TIMESTAMP noting the last recorded location update time.
An enum (TransportMode_enum) indicating the mode of transport (e.g., 'Road', 'Rail', 'Air', 'Sea').
A TEXT field with carrier or transporter identification/labeling information.
A VARCHAR(50) referencing any carrier certification or license number.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Links vehicle to a shipment in transit.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Links the vehicle to a container in transit.
